description: Distilled GEMM-family flash pack. B is JxK. Gold C from zero. Sizes come from kernel.h (I/J/K or I_P/J_P/K_P). Not the 90-skill dump, not PE_BLK-16-only, not 64x64 ping-pong, not AutoSA netlist clone.

skills.pattern: GEMM rewrite that indexes B as B[k][j] or C += A[k][i]*B[k][j] when the header is B[J][K]
skills.strategy: Keep kernel.h ranks. A is I x K, B is J x K, C is I x J (catapult: I_P/J_P/K_P). MAC is A[i][k]*B[j][k].
required_steps: index B[j][k] not B[k][j] unless the header says otherwise
do not transpose in place
keep the exact extern C top from kernel.h
guards: mm-family gold is C=A*B with B stored J x K

skills.pattern: kernel loads DRAM C and accumulates into it, or leaves C uninitialized
skills.strategy: C is write-only. Init C_local to 0 or assign the full dot. Do not read host C.
required_steps: skip load_C
C_local starts at 0 or is assigned the complete product
store C once

skills.pattern: 64-class GEMM still computes from m_axi, or a large GEMM complete-partitions full A/B/C
skills.strategy: If A,B,C fit, stage all three. If not, tile K and/or J. Never complete-partition a 1024^3 workspace.
required_steps: bytes = (I*K + J*K + I*J) * sizeof(data_t) using header macros
if they fit, A_local/B_local/C_local then LCST
if they do not, keep tiles on-chip only
guards: 64x64x64 float fits; 1024^3 float usually does not

skills.pattern: C_local RMW or linearized g so Final II=4
skills.strategy: Nested i / j. Assign C_local[row][col] = dot. No old+dot. No g shifts.
required_steps: affine i and j
write-once C_local
skip load_C
guards: II=4 with DSP around 636 is this bug, not missing PE width

skills.pattern: K sequential or one float acc += a*b under a claimed II=1 C pipeline
skills.strategy: UNROLL k into partial sums / adder tree. Not a serial FP accumulator.
required_steps: UNROLL k (or k tiles of 8 then reduce)
dot = tree of products; write-once C_local
if Final II>>1 from one dadd, split more lanes
guards: full K unroll without a tree still II>>1

skills.pattern: A/B/C share bundle=gmem or load/store is one float per cycle
required_steps: m_axi A bundle=gmem0, B gmem1, C gmem2
load/store step by LANES
keep narrow data_t ABI

skills.pattern: one loop that issues A and B AXI in lockstep so csynth prices II=1 but RTL stalls on either port
skills.strategy: Load A and load B as separate pipelines that may overlap. Do not fuse A+B into one trip. The 871-cycle fused design is a failure mode.
required_steps: separate load_A and load_B loops or tasks
do not put A[i][k] and B[j][k] reads in the same II=1 body as the only DRAM schedule
guards: csynth of fused A+B can look faster than RTL; do not target that number
skills.template:
// GOOD: load_A pipeline; load_B pipeline; then compute.
// BAD: for (t) { a = A[...]; b = B[...]; } as the only DRAM schedule.

skills.pattern: rewrite emits a stripped AutoSA interconnect, A_t16 host-serialize, L2/L1 FIFOs, or a 16x4 mm_pe chain copied from rank-1
skills.strategy: Keep the kernel.h top. Reverse-engineering AutoSA then asking the model to emit it is not this bin. Systolic I/O is a different pack.
required_steps: top remains the kernel.h name and parameter list
zero AutoSA interconnect names
no K-tiles unless the working set does not fit
guards: iso-compute 320 DSP systolic is the systolic I/O pack
spend-DSP on-chip is a different pack
skills.template:
// Keep autosa_mm_hcl(A[I][K], B[J][K], C[I][J]) or the kernel.h equivalent.
// Do not emit an AutoSA host-serialize netlist.
